segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Bandra! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine: a party in four acts, eight offers, and more confetti than is strictly sensible.

segments.title: ₹33L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Bandra is 33 lakh rupees. That's 20 per cent up on last April. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 16.8 lakh rupees. That's 5 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 8.91 lakh, comebacks 5.94 lakh, and everything else 1.32 lakh. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 106 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 944 leads, 491 trials, and 106 buyers, with about 22 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.
Here's where the offers come in. Eight offers carry 25 lakh rupees, which is 76 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: Moving In Together (The 9-Month Lease)
segments.text: First up, Moving In Together, the nine-month lease. Nine months unlimited, nine freezes, the anniversary hoodie and a numbered brass key. That's 4 buyers, for 5.8 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members ready for a long commitment and returning clients who want the best price of the year.

segments.title: The 9:09 Panic Attack
segments.text: Next, the nine-oh-nine panic attack. The limited nine-class pack. That's 12 buyers, for 1.38 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.

segments.title: The Cloud Nine 90
segments.text: Then, for our heaviest users, the Cloud Nine ninety. Ninety classes, one year, about fifteen hundred rupees a class in Mumbai. That's 1 buyer, for 1.35 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Also this month, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine extra days. That's 6 buyers, for 1.03 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: After that, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes for nine ninety-nine, party class included, credited against a first month. That's 15 buyers, for 2.43 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
segments.text: Next, for lapsed members, Faking Your Own Death Didn't Work. They get an obituary postcard, which is also their ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class. That's 13 buyers, for 2.24 lakh rupees.

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: Then, for renewals, Spin Class. Literally. Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 30 buyers, for 5.46 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.

segments.title: Club Nine: The Founders’ Table
segments.text: And finally, Club Nine, the Founders' Table. Nine numbered annual seats per studio, with the perks doubled: four privates, eight guest passes, priority booking all year and a numbered jacket. That's 3 buyers, for 5.27 lakh rupees.
segments.notes: Members on 3-Month or longer plans; annual renewers.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, Platinum Hour, the launch film, and the numbered keys go live with a public counter. Week two, anniversary week: the wheel, the plank-off, Barre-stie day and the nine-oh-nine panic attack. Week three, obituary postcards, the Séance Class, the Club Nine unveiling and nine at nine on the eighteenth. Week four, the Throwback Reunion, the Golden Glute Awards, and a midnight lock-in on the thirtieth.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Bandra. 33 lakh rupees, eight offers, and 106 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
